recipes.name: Nickie's Apple-Pecan Cheesecake
ingredients_raw: 4 cups apples (about 3) - peeled, cored, and chopped

steps.text: Preheat oven to 325 degrees F (165 degrees C). Line a 9x13 inch baking dish with aluminum foil, extending the foil sheets over the side of the dish.
To make the crust, mix the graham cracker crumbs, butter, and 2 tablespoons brown sugar together in a bowl until evenly blended. Press evenly over the bottom of the prepared baking dish.

To make the filling, beat the cream cheese, 1 cup brown sugar, and vanilla together in a mixing bowl until evenly blended. Beat in the sour cream. On low speed, add the eggs, one at a time, just until blended. Pour the mixture over the crust.
To make the topping, place the apples in a bowl, and toss with 1/2 cup brown sugar, pecans, and cinnamon until evenly blended.
Bake in preheated oven until center is almost set, about 55 minutes. Cool, and refrigerate 4 hours, or overnight.

Before cutting, allow the cheesecake to sit 30 minutes at room temperature, then lift from the baking dish using the extended aluminum foil sheets, and place on a cutting board or serving plate. Remove the aluminum foil, and cut into 16 squares.

raw_recipe.headline: Nickie's Apple-Pecan Cheesecake
raw_recipe.description: A creamy cheesecake layer is topped with cinnamon, pecan, and brown sugar-seasoned apples in this autumn dessert guaranteed to be a hit at all parties from Thanksgiving through New Year.

review.reviewBody:
I'm the pastry chef for victoria's secret cafe. I made this for a lunch special and it lasted all of 1 hour before people were asking for more. This cheesecake is wonderful, I will definately be making it again soon. Thank you for the recipe. 
Chef Clum

I have made this so many times I almost know it by heart. It’s delicious and my family and coworkers ask for it and rave about it. I do follow some of the other suggestions. I precook the apples with the cinnamon and sugar(this can also save prep time because I can make them ahead of time). I add cinnamon to the filling and the crust. And I add a crumble topping made with flour brown sugar and butter crumbled on the top. If I choose to add pecans I sprinkle them over the crumble topping. I do cook it for an hour but turn the oven off and leave it in there for another hour.

I was tempted to make this in a springform, but stuck to the recipe for my first try. Remember that a 13x9 pan has 117 sq. inches and a 10" springform only has 78.5 sq inches. That's why you need to increase the cooking time to 1 hour and 15 minutes if you make the switch. I don't like graham cracker crust so I used vanilla wafers instead. I also added a tsp of cinnamon to the filling. It was very tasty and folks at the office raved.
I cut the recipe in half and used a round 9 inch pan lined with foil. I put the pan in a water bath. It still took 55 minutes to bake.

Everyone in our house and my DH work LOVED it. I found this recipe in a magazine-you know, plugging their ingredients-that said to bake at 325 for 1hr - 1hr+5min. For my oven (always a little cooler, I guess) I baked it 1hr+10min. My apples still looked wonderful. CHANGES: Added 1 Tbsp lemon juice to the cream cheese mixture(maybe a little more) and increased pecans in the topping to 1 cup (also, maybe a little more.) We love pecans in Texas! The 3 textures--creamy filling, chewy apples, and crunchy nuts make this desert heavenly. And using the foil as a liner to lift it out was really easy. Everyone at my DH office that tried it asked for the recipe. I didn't want to type it over for them. So I looked on AllRecipes. Yeah! It was here. Thanks for posting this winner for us lazy recipe hounds!
I loved this recipe and so did my guests.I added 1 Tsp of cinnamon to the cheesecake batter....we all love cinnamon...it was great!

nice cheesecake especially for guests, just one thought; the apples could use a little cooking before putting them on the top, cooking in the oven does not make them very soft. They remain too crispy.

I doubled the crust so glad I did. It gave me more to work with so I could the crust up around the edges. I did need to keep it in the oven for about 12 more minuets longer. We had family and friends over for a fish fry and topped the dinner off with this pie. It was an absolute HIT!!!!

Best ever cheesecake! I did not have graham crackers so I made filling and poured into (2) pre-made graham cracker crusts. The filling fit beautifully. I baked for 1 hour and when serving drizzled caramel sauce. It was a hit! Can't wait to get graham crackers and make it per the recipe! It's a no fail recipe!

This was delicious! Had a great fluffy texture and a rich, not too sweet taste. Made it for Thanksgiving and everyone loved it! The only change I made was to use vanilla wafers instead of graham crackers for the crust because I do not like graham crackers. I will definitely be making this again & again!
Very good! I made half the recipe and baked in a 9" premade graham crust for convenience.
I used a Springform pan. Hope it turns out good. I made this before following a different recipe. It was yummy! Hope it is good time too.
This recipe is awesome!!! Everyone complimented it, it was a hit o i will definitely make this cheesecake again!

Will make it as it sounds delicious with all of the different flavors. But - although not stated in directions - is it obvious that the apples are spread on top before baking. 

Thank you!
I made this in my 12 in spring-form pan and added caramel bits. Everyone loved it!
The apples were chewy and the flavor was just good.
This was the first cheesecake I have ever made. What a hit! Everyone loved it! Will make again and recommend!!
My customer's love this cheesecake
I made this for work and it was a hit !!! Now sum coworkers want me to make for ther hollidays
Tried this recipe for Christmas and it was a HUGE hit! Everyone ate my cheesecake and forgot about the other deserts there! Love it and will definetly be making it again!
